Opponent may not add destiny draws to total power or attrition here. While with a Skywalker or Jedi, Vader’s defense value is +2 (maximum of 8) and his immunity to attrition is +2. When Vader leaves table, place Effect in Used Pile. (Immune to [[Alter]].) |errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image here is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-10E-Revenge_Of_The_Sith.png]]). The same words were published again on the Players Committee card image and in the Virtual Cards Master List of 2013; the current text is [[Revenge Of The Sith (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 3)]] (Master List, PC-E3). * '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet, official text as of 15 March 2010 (slip 3•10E)[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 15 March 2010"; released 12 March 2010; copy re-made 4 April 2010), page 3, slip 3•10E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095315/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]: “Deploy on Vader. [Coruscant] holograms are lost. When Vader leaves table, place Effect in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-10E-Revenge_Of_The_Sith.png]]) prints it. The slip prints slip number 3•10E at the bottom right. The card was first published on the Virtual Block 6.3 (Mercenaries) release sheet, which the Players Committee released on 12 March 2010, three days before the date the sheet carries (“official text as of 15 March 2010”)Players Committee home page, news “Virtual Block 6.3: Mercenaries – Released!”, posted 4:40pm Friday, 12 March 2010, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20100409002355/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ 9 April 2010] (Internet Archive); the Players Committee Twitter account wrote on 13 March 2010 that the set “has been released early!” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20100721144451/http://twitter.com/swccg Internet Archive copy]). * '''PC-E1''' ([[Revenge Of The Sith (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 6 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock6Type (Virtual Block 6 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.: “Deploy on Vader. [Coruscant] holograms are lost. Opponent may not add destiny draws to total power or attrition here. While with a Skywalker or Jedi, Vader’s defense value is +2 (to a maximum of 8) and his immunity to attrition is +2. When Vader leaves table, place Effect in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' One change: “to a” is added (“(to a maximum of 8)”). The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image. * '''PC-E2''' ([[Revenge Of The Sith (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-revengeofthesith-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013Players Committee card image folder (Virtual6-Dark/large/), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034706/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.: “Deploy on Vader. [Coruscant] holograms are lost. Opponent may not add destiny draws to total power or attrition here. While with a Skywalker or Jedi, Vader’s defense value is +2 (maximum of 8) and his immunity to attrition is +2. When Vader leaves table, place Effect in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word, undoing the card-list changes listed under PC-E1. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date, and what was uploaded last counts as the last version). Besides the words, the image differs from the release-sheet slip in one visible way: it prints slip number 3•10 without the E (the release-sheet slip prints 3•10E). * '''PC-E3''' ([[Revenge Of The Sith (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 30)[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014).
